evaluation: Position-only scalar float32 inference, deterministic argmax, no exploration or action masking; original author environment until exit or step301. Record every start and every fixed checkpoint. Inference actions may be cached because the policy sees only position.
metadata: For each checkpoint, completed episodes and epsilon come from the most recent fully completed journal row at or before the checkpoint. No future row contributes. A budget-cut row does not decay epsilon. Final epoch metadata must match saved completion.
selection: All nine existing models and all three saved checkpoints. Final scores already known, earlier checkpoint scores not inspected before freezing. No best-checkpoint selection, retraining or substitution.
decision: Always close this bounded diagnosis after the27 checkpoints, including mixed results. Summarize per-model monotone improvement, monotone decline, rise-then-fall, fall-then-rise or flat. Two adjacent changes cannot identify a unique mechanism or establish convergence. Flag consistent temporal decline as a future stability question, not automatic authorization to expand training.
missing_checkpoint_rule: Report any missing or corrupt checkpoint explicitly; do not substitute another time or retry training.
verification: Recompute all actions and paths independently with a coordinate transition table and FED integration; exactly match all nine200k saved endpoint trajectories; verify source hashes before and after. Verification rollouts are repeat checks, not additional independent evidence.
